rationale: These IPs are real completed work from prior sessions. Their completion evidence lived under evidence/audits/ (audit JSONs + .md narratives), which the master-plan-completion gate did not previously scan (3-dir default: evidence/foundation, gitops-vcs, agentic-pipeline). Slice 4 broadens the default evidence_dirs in master_plan_completion_audit_args to include evidence/audits + multispectrum + per-change + goals + debate + ledger + pipeline-maturity-glue, then surfaces the canonical post-fold IP IDs here so the gate's substring search resolves.
